answer: Geofenced ambient radio presence requires each identity to submit signed samples from one physical receiver. Enforcement matches a site’s multipath profile, including reflections from basalt walls, to prior samples. It checks ambient noise against cipher tags; duplicate or replayed fingerprints collapse to one identity. A zenith reference replay fails because local drift changes the profile. Each sybil needs a separate occupied site and live receiver, paying hardware, power, and calibration downtime.
